why_conditional.reason: Every hypothesis blaming Dataset V1 for the observed regression is refuted by the frozen data; 19 of 20 held-out outputs carry phrasing absent from all 600 V1 responses. The regression is dominated by the epoch-3 checkpoint.
why_conditional.consequence: Selecting a V2 intervention now would target a training artifact.

prerequisite_baseline.name: N600_V1_BASELINE
prerequisite_baseline.definition: Dataset V1, N=600, MVP recipe plus checkpoint-selection correction
prerequisite_baseline.correction_note: Applied identically to the V1 baseline and to V2, so the V1-vs-V2 comparison isolates data. Not claimable as the Early Submission improvement.
prerequisite_baseline.why_not_recoverable: save_total_limit: 1 pruned the epoch-1 and epoch-2 adapters during the MVP run.

hypotheses.name: multi-turn adaptation
hypotheses.measured_failure: failure to adapt to a learner's established findings across turns
hypotheses.dataset_evidence: every assistant turn in V1's synthetic conversation histories is a well-aimed teacher hint, so the model never sees a tutor recovering from a prior move that missed
hypotheses.data_property_changed: conversation histories of a subset of multi-turn examples, so the prior assistant turn is misaimed and the target response must redirect without restating it
hypotheses.standing_evidence: tuned model passed 0/5 multi-turn and 5/15 first-turn scenarios despite V1 being 79.8% multi-turn

hypotheses.name: solved-state release
hypotheses.measured_failure: withholding after the learner has already produced the fix
hypotheses.dataset_evidence: V1's 85 solved-state examples are 14.2% of the data and all sit at turn 2 or later
hypotheses.data_property_changed: proportion and turn-position spread of solved-state examples

hypotheses.name: hint-policy consistency
hypotheses.measured_failure: hints aimed at the wrong part of the program
hypotheses.dataset_evidence: V1 mixes hint_strength narrow=234, nudge=206, pointed=160 with nothing in the learner-visible input indicating which applies
hypotheses.data_property_changed: hint-strength distribution collapsed to a single consistent policy, off-policy examples regenerated at the retained strength
hypotheses.standing_evidence: hint_strength is a generation dimension not derivable from the scenario the model sees

withdrawn_hypotheses.claim: The V1 gate never checked hints against the scenario's expected_bug.
withdrawn_hypotheses.refutation: evaluation/judge.py places 'Actual bug:' and 'Correct fix:' in the judge prompt and defines hint_relevance as how directly the move points at the actual bug. V1 scores mean 0.950 on it.

branches.note: No data-attributable failure survives the correction. Report that the MVP's apparent data defect was a checkpoint defect; propose V2 but do not claim it.

primary.rule: V - B >= +0.10 absolute on the selected hypothesis's target metric
primary.and_also: the change is at least 2 scenarios out of 20

success_criteria.reporting_rule: At n=20 a delta below 0.10 is not claimable and is reported as directional. Raw counts accompany every rate.

construction_constraints.n_rationale: V2 replaces examples rather than adding them, so the comparison isolates data content, not data quantity.
construction_constraints.exceeding_cap_requires: a written justification in PLAN.md Amendments before V2 is built
unchanged_from_v1: contamination check against scenarios/clean.jsonl, adversarial.jsonl, heldout.jsonl
required_deliverables: V1-vs-V2 distribution comparison across pressure_type, bug_category, language, difficulty, turn position, student_progress

explicitly_not_the_v2_intervention: any other training-configuration or checkpoint-selection change
